visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Nested Comprehension Instead of Loops with append
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two nested loops and a temporary row list build the multiplication grid. Use a nested list comprehension. The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
grid = []
for i in range(3):
    row = []
    for j in range(4):
        row.append(i * j)
    grid.append(row)
print(grid)

solution.code:
grid = [[i * j for j in range(4)] for i in range(3)]
print(grid)
solution.explanation: The comprehension describes the grid in one line, and each row is created by the inner expression, so rows can never be accidentally shared.
